issue_request: FHIR-15141 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core issue asking the conformance-module Common use Cases text to say that a server may act as a repository of NamingSystem resources rather than NameSpace resources.

additional_context: The current source retains the NamingSystem wording at source/conformance-module.html:160, and source/hierarchy.xml lists conformance-module.html as the Conformance module page. Current-source search found no remaining NameSpace spelling. Jira term search surfaced the broader historical FHIR-3630 Namespace-to-NamingSystem rename as background, while Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-15141 references or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The reconciliation published an empty no-change audit commit because the active current source already satisfies the Jira request and the historical application remains intact.
